landing.featuresHeading: Built for African and global creators
landing.feature1Desc: Every script opens with a curiosity gap tested to stop the scroll.
landing.feature2Desc: Lock a character card and reference portrait so stories stay consistent.
landing.feature3Desc: Scripts are written natively in your reel language, never translated word for word.

landing.pricingSubheading: Pay with MTN or Orange Money. A 3% mobile money processing fee is shown clearly at checkout.
landing.faq1Q: How many reels can I make with 1,000 credits?
landing.faq1A: About 4 to 7 full reels depending on length, voice tier, and whether you use a recurring character. A 30-second reel starts at 141 credits.
landing.faq2Q: How do I pay with MTN or Orange Money?
landing.faq2A: Choose any plan or top-up pack in the Credits tab, pick MTN Mobile Money or Orange Money, and confirm the prompt on your phone.
landing.faq3Q: What happens if a generation fails?
landing.faq3A: If any step fails permanently, your reserved credits are automatically refunded to your balance.
landing.faq4Q: Can I use my own voice or music?
landing.faq4A: Yes. You can upload MP3, WAV, or M4A audio files up to 20 MB with rights confirmation, and those steps cost zero credits.
landing.faq5Q: Which languages are supported for reels?
landing.faq5A: Reely AI writes and narrates natively in English, French, Spanish, Italian, German, and Portuguese.
landing.faq6A: Monthly plan credits reset at the end of each billing cycle. Top-up packs remain valid for 90 days.
landing.faq7Q: Can I edit a script or scene after it finishes?
landing.faq7A: Yes. Open any reel to rewrite narration lines, swap motion presets, change music, or regenerate a single scene.
landing.faq8Q: Does Reely AI post directly to TikTok or Reels?
landing.faq8A: No. You download the finished vertical video and thumbnail directly to your device and post on any platform you choose.

legal.termsBody: Reely AI provides automated video storytelling tools. You retain responsibility for topics you submit and must confirm rights for any uploaded voice or music files. Automated accounts, impersonation of real individuals, and prohibited content are not permitted. Credit purchases are denominated in XAF and processed via mobile money.
legal.privacyBody: We store your account profile, created reels, characters, and billing records solely to operate your studio workspace. Prompts and scripts are processed server-side and are never shared publicly without your action. Deleting your account removes your projects, characters, and uploaded assets.
